source: topk-moe/inputs/topk-moe.cu + topk-moe.cuh; native warp algorithm and order preserved; original topk/softmax/sort functions are not called and no serial full sort substitutes the warp logic
status: source-only migration; no build, GPU execution or native comparison was run by this worker; parent owns bridge, builds and gates

entry.device: topk_row(p:i64,row:u64,lane:i32) in device.goose; one warp per row; lane=threadIdx.x; row=blockIdx.x*rows_per_block+threadIdx.y
entry.launch: grid.x=ceil(n_rows/8), block=(32,8)=256 threads, dynamic shared memory 0 bytes, warp width 32
entry.platform: platform may clamp row to n_rows-1 instead of early return (duplicate identical last-row stores, native-identical); HIP<6.3 group-mask gating is a parent bridge concern
entry.dummy_main: fn main() calls topk_row(0,0,0); parent never executes dummy mains

node_src.2: clamp tensor or null (presence enables with_norm)

node_op_params_int.0: flags bit0 sigmoid bit1 sqrt_softplus bit2 delayed_softmax

iv.3: flags bit0 sigmoid bit1 sqrt_softplus bit2 with_norm bit3 delayed_softmax bit4 has_bias

plan.unused: dims/strides/magic keys unused; row addressing is contiguous

device_externs.fg171t_load: load(p:u64,i:u64)->f32 raw F32 load by element index

host_externs: fg171t_arg, fg171t_plan_ptr, fg171t_hget/hput/hfloat, fg171t_ti (keys: 0 src,1 data ptr,2 type,3 ne,4 nb bytes,8 op_params int32,9 checked ggml_nbytes span, must call), fg171t_tf, fg171t_contiguous, fg171t_f32_type, fg171t_i32_type (only ABI addition vs fg168 set, needed for the native ids GGML_TYPE_I32 assert), fg171t_launch, fg171t_fail

storage_bounds.fixed_arrays: wt, sel, outw are f32[18]; MAX_EPT=18 covers the largest supported n_experts=576; every loop is bounded by runtime ept = n_experts>32 ? n_experts/32 : 1; parent may clone device.goose with ept constant-folded per n_experts for performance
storage_bounds.addressing: logits[expert + n_experts*row] F32; weights[idx + n_expert_used*row] F32; ids[k + n_experts*row] I32 (native stride quirk: full n_experts row stride, only first n_expert_used entries written); bias[expert] F32
storage_bounds.required_spans: logits n_experts*n_rows F32; weights n_expert_used*n_rows F32; ids n_experts*n_rows I32; bias n_experts F32; every tensor span checked host-side via ti(t,9,0)
storage_bounds.offset_math: all element offsets computed in u64; dimensions bounded to INT32_MAX by policy

native_contract.order: per row: guard, -INF slot init, PDL sync, coalesced logits load, block barrier, transform, NaN sanitize, bias selection view, optional group mask, PDL launch-completion, k=0..n_expert_used-1 selection rounds (ascending k, ids written per round), optional norm, optional delayed softmax, ascending scaled store
native_contract.tie: strict > local scan (first slot = lowest expert of the thread wins), xor reduction accepts only val>max or (val==max && expert<max); initial max_expert=lane is unguarded like native; lowest expert index wins every tie; the selected comparison slot is set to -INF before the next round
native_contract.nan: NaN in wt is sanitized to exactly -FLT_MAX before selection on every path, so selection never compares NaN; an all-NaN or all -INF row deterministically selects experts 0..k-1; delayed softmax over an all -INF selection produces NaN weights (native-identical; compare bitwise, never with tolerances)
native_contract.tail: n_experts<32: lanes>=n_experts load -INF, are excluded from selection by the range guard, and contribute exp(-INF)=0 to softmax sums; sigmoid/sqrt-softplus map out-of-range slots to 0.0 but the guard still excludes them; k tail: outw slots >= n_expert_used stay 0, are zeroed by the delayed softmax, and are never stored
native_contract.groups: n_per_group=n_experts/n_groups; group(expert)=idx/n_per_group; group score=top1+top2 from the selection array via full-warp top-2 shuffle reduce; rank counts strictly greater scores plus lower-index ties; ballot keeps group g when lane g has rank<n_group_used; experts with idx>=n_groups*n_per_group are always -INF (native tail semantics, visible when n_experts%n_groups!=0); policy rejects n_groups>32, n_groups>n_experts (n_per_group==0 is native UB) and n_group_used<1
native_contract.alias: weights and ids may alias logits: one block barrier after all row loads protects them; bias must not alias outputs (native has no protection)
native_contract.inf_rep: -INFINITY is derived as -(FLT_MAX*2) with FLT_MAX built from exact f32 steps ((8192*8192) squared twice, times 2^24-1); no bitcasts, no fragile literals
native_contract.softmax_note: pre-top-k softmax runs over all ept slots without limit (out-of-range -INF slots become exactly 0); delayed softmax runs over output weights with limit n_expert_used and zeroes inactive slots; local max uses native std::max semantics (strict update), warp max uses fmaxf NaN rules

policy_fail_codes.7: n_experts not in supported instantiation set
policy_fail_codes.8: n_expert_used > n_experts (duplicate-id input rejected; native would emit duplicates)
policy_fail_codes.13: bias tensor invalid or too small

variant_coverage: softmax, sigmoid, sqrt-softplus, delayed softmax, bias selection, group masking, normalization with clamp, and scaling are all implemented; no variant tagged not-migrated; combinations allowed except with_norm+delayed
